title: Bundled Child in Winter Coat on Brick Stoop, 1948 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from April 1948 showing a young child warmly bundled for cold weather, standing on a concrete path in front of a brick stoop and staircase. The child is dressed in a dark winter coat, a fitted hood, a neatly tied plaid woolen scarf, sturdy dark shoes, and holds a pair of light-colored gloves or mittens. The setting reflects typical residential architecture and postwar domestic life in late 1940s America.
